M7-e also took over the LIVE-ARTIFACT half of M6-e, a documented handoff recorded in check-site.sh: M6's window had a lower bound of m6_entry-3000 = 856,745, which this milestone lawfully shed past, and M6-e now judges only the M6 record and the (untouched) exercise-bundle figures.
